## GenBank export

```{r genbank-write}
features      <- build_genbank_features(annotation, q, meta)
comment_lines <- build_genbank_comments(meta)

results_dir <- file.path("results", gene_id)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

safe_name <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "_", q$gene_name)
gbk_path  <- file.path(results_dir, sprintf("%s_%s.gbk", q$name, safe_name))
write_genbank(gbk_path, q$gene_name, q$name, q$sequence, features, comment_lines)

cat(sprintf("Wrote %s (%d features)\n", gbk_path, length(features)))
```
